name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs, set aside. Fry garlic, add cold rice, stir in soy sauce, fold in eggs and spring onion.

name: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Drain chickpeas, dice vegetables, toss with lemon juice and olive oil, season to taste.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oats
instructions: Cook oats with milk, mash in banana, swirl in peanut butter.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Sear diced chicken, add garlic and ginger, add vegetables, finish with soy sauce.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute onion, carrot and garlic, add lentils and stock, simmer until soft, season with cumin.

name: Tuna Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, toss with tuna, olive oil, garlic and a squeeze of lemon.
